-- What a client importing `Proof.sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.Defs` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def smd.fieldsL (S : smd.Schema) (e : smd.TypeRef) (ks : List GoString) (p : smd.Path) : List
    smd.UVal → smd.PathSet :=
  smd.UVal.brecOn_1 x✝ (smd.fieldsAt._f S) (smd.fieldsL._f S) (smd.fieldsM._f S) (fun t f => PUnit.unit) e ks p

def smd.removeAt (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (R : smd.PathSet) : smd.UVal → smd.UVal :=
  x✝.brecOn (smd.removeAt._f S) (smd.removeL._f S) (smd.removeM._f S) (fun t f => PUnit.unit) t R

def smd.conformsM (S : smd.Schema) (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (e : Option smd.TypeRef) :
    List (GoString × smd.UVal) → Bool :=
  smd.UVal.brecOn_2 x✝ (smd.conformsB._f S) (smd.conformsL._f S) (smd.conformsM._f S) (fun t f => PUnit.unit) fs e

def smd.Cmp.unionAll (cs : List smd.Cmp) : smd.Cmp :=
  List.foldr smd.Cmp.union smd.Cmp.none cs

def smd.conformsL (S : smd.Schema) (e : smd.TypeRef) : List smd.UVal → Bool :=
  smd.UVal.brecOn_1 x✝ (smd.conformsB._f S) (smd.conformsL._f S) (smd.conformsM._f S) (fun t f => PUnit.unit) e

def smd.instDecidableEqCmp : DecidableEq smd.Cmp :=
  decidable_of_iff (a.removed = b.removed ∧ a.modified = b.modified ∧ a.added = b.added) ⋯

def smd.reconcile (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) : smd.PathSet :=
  have ns := smd.atomicNodes S t s;
  (smd.FSet.filter (fun q => !smd.FSet.any (fun p => List.isPrefixOf p q) ns) s).union ns

def smd.instDecidableSchemaConsistent (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) :
    Decidable (smd.schemaConsistent S t s) :=
  smd.instDecidableSchemaConsistent._aux_1 S t s

def smd.strictPrefixes : smd.Path → List smd.Path :=
  List.brecOn x✝ smd.strictPrefixes._f

def smd.conformsB (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) : smd.UVal → Bool :=
  x✝.brecOn (smd.conformsB._f S) (smd.conformsL._f S) (smd.conformsM._f S) (fun t f => PUnit.unit) t

def smd.Cmp.union (a b : smd.Cmp) : smd.Cmp :=
  { removed := a.removed.union b.removed, modified := a.modified.union b.modified, added := a.added.union b.added }

def smd.reconChild (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (pe : smd.PE) : Option smd.TypeRef :=
  match S.find t.name with
  | some (smd.Atom.map fs e rel) =>
    match pe with
    | smd.PE.field n => smd.fieldType fs e n
    | x => e
  | some (smd.Atom.list e rel keys) => some e
  | x => none

def smd.compare (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (l r : smd.UVal) : smd.Cmp :=
  smd.cmpF (l.size + r.size + 1) S t [] (some l) (some r)

def smd.removeM (S : smd.Schema) (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (e : Option smd.TypeRef) (R :
    smd.PathSet) : List (GoString × smd.UVal) → List (GoString × smd.UVal) :=
  smd.UVal.brecOn_2 x✝ (smd.removeAt._f S) (smd.removeL._f S) (smd.removeM._f S) (fun t f => PUnit.unit) fs e R

def smd.removeL (S : smd.Schema) (e : smd.TypeRef) (ks : List GoString) (R : smd.PathSet) : List
    smd.UVal → List smd.UVal :=
  smd.UVal.brecOn_1 x✝ (smd.removeAt._f S) (smd.removeL._f S) (smd.removeM._f S) (fun t f => PUnit.unit) e ks R

def smd.mergeF : Nat → smd.Schema → smd.TypeRef → Option smd.UVal → Option smd.UVal → Option
    smd.UVal :=
  Nat.brecOn (motive := fun x => smd.Schema → smd.TypeRef → Option smd.UVal → Option smd.UVal → Option smd.UVal) x✝⁴
    smd.mergeF._f x✝³ x✝² x✝¹ x✝

def smd.schemaConsistent (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) : Prop :=
  smd.FSet.isEmpty (smd.atomicNodes S t s) = true

def smd.leafC (p : smd.Path) (l r : Option smd.UVal) : smd.Cmp :=
  match l, r with
  | none, x => { removed := smd.empty, modified := smd.empty, added := smd.ins p }
  | x, none => { removed := smd.ins p, modified := smd.empty, added := smd.empty }
  | some a, some b => if a = b then smd.Cmp.none else { removed := smd.empty, modified := smd.ins p, added := smd.empty }

def smd.fieldSet (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal) : smd.PathSet :=
  smd.fieldsAt S t [] x

def smd.fieldsAt (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (p : smd.Path) : smd.UVal → smd.PathSet :=
  x✝.brecOn (smd.fieldsAt._f S) (smd.fieldsL._f S) (smd.fieldsM._f S) (fun t f => PUnit.unit) t p

def smd.flSort (fl : smd.FieldList) : smd.FieldList :=
  List.foldl (fun acc f => smd.flInsert f acc) [] fl

def smd.flInsert (f : GoString × smd.UVal) : smd.FieldList → smd.FieldList :=
  List.brecOn x✝ (smd.flInsert._f f)

def smd.ins (p : smd.Path) : smd.PathSet :=
  smd.PathSet.single p

def smd.listItems : Option smd.UVal → List smd.UVal :=
  match x✝ with
  | some (smd.UVal.list vs) => vs
  | x => []

def smd.conforms (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal) : Prop :=
  smd.conformsB S t x = true

def smd.atomicNodes (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) : smd.PathSet :=
  smd.FSet.filter
    (fun p =>
      !List.isEmpty p &&
        match smd.reconAt S t p with
        | some t' => smd.isAtomicT S t'
        | none => false)
    (smd.FSet.bind smd.strictPrefixes s)

def smd.isGranularT (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) : Bool :=
  match S.find t.name with
  | some (smd.Atom.list elem rel keys) => decide (rel ≠ smd.ElemRel.atomic)
  | some (smd.Atom.map fields elem rel) => decide (rel ≠ smd.ElemRel.atomic)
  | x => false

def smd.mergeKeys (L R : List smd.PE) : List smd.PE :=
  smd.mergeOrderF (L.length + R.length + 1) (fun x => decide (x ∈ R)) L R (List.filter (fun x => decide (x ∈ L)) R) []

def smd.mergeOrderF : Nat → (smd.PE → Bool) → List smd.PE → List smd.PE → List smd.PE → List smd.PE
    → List smd.PE :=
  Nat.brecOn (motive := fun x => (smd.PE → Bool) → List smd.PE → List smd.PE → List smd.PE → List smd.PE → List smd.PE)
    x✝⁵ smd.mergeOrderF._f x✝⁴ x✝³ x✝² x✝¹ x✝

def smd.cmpF : Nat → smd.Schema → smd.TypeRef → smd.Path → Option smd.UVal → Option smd.UVal →
    smd.Cmp :=
  Nat.brecOn (motive := fun x => smd.Schema → smd.TypeRef → smd.Path → Option smd.UVal → Option smd.UVal → smd.Cmp) x✝⁵
    smd.cmpF._f x✝⁴ x✝³ x✝² x✝¹ x✝

def (sealed) smd.isTV (p sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal) : IProp GF

def smd.mapItems : Option smd.UVal → List (GoString × smd.UVal) :=
  match x✝ with
  | some (smd.UVal.map kvs) => kvs
  | x => []

def smd.isAtomicT (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) : Bool :=
  match S.find t.name with
  | some (smd.Atom.list elem smd.ElemRel.atomic keys) => true
  | some (smd.Atom.map fields elem smd.ElemRel.atomic) => true
  | x => false

def smd.union (a b : smd.PathSet) : smd.PathSet :=
  a.union b

def smd.reconAt (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) : smd.Path → Option smd.TypeRef :=
  List.brecOn (motive := fun x => smd.TypeRef → Option smd.TypeRef) x✝ (smd.reconAt._f S) t

def smd.keysOf (ks : List GoString) (vs : List smd.UVal) : List smd.PE :=
  List.filterMap (smd.keyOf ks) vs

structure smd.Cmp : Type where
  removed : smd.PathSet
  modified : smd.PathSet
  added : smd.PathSet

def smd.nodeC (p : smd.Path) (l r : Option smd.UVal) : smd.Cmp :=
  match l, r with
  | none, x => { removed := smd.empty, modified := smd.empty, added := smd.ins p }
  | x, none => { removed := smd.ins p, modified := smd.empty, added := smd.empty }
  | x, x_1 => smd.Cmp.none

def smd.scalarOk : smd.Scalar → smd.UVal → Bool :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | x, smd.UVal.null => true
  | smd.Scalar.numeric, smd.UVal.int i => true
  | smd.Scalar.string, smd.UVal.str s => true
  | smd.Scalar.boolean, smd.UVal.bool b => true
  | smd.Scalar.untyped, smd.UVal.int i => true
  | smd.Scalar.untyped, smd.UVal.str s => true
  | smd.Scalar.untyped, smd.UVal.bool b => true
  | x, x_1 => false

def smd.Cmp.none : smd.Cmp :=
  { removed := smd.empty, modified := smd.empty, added := smd.empty }

def smd.fieldsM (S : smd.Schema) (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (e : Option smd.TypeRef) (p :
    smd.Path) : List (GoString × smd.UVal) → smd.PathSet :=
  smd.UVal.brecOn_2 x✝ (smd.fieldsAt._f S) (smd.fieldsL._f S) (smd.fieldsM._f S) (fun t f => PUnit.unit) fs e p

def smd.itemOf (ks : List GoString) (vs : List smd.UVal) (pe : smd.PE) : Option smd.UVal :=
  List.find? (fun v => decide (smd.keyOf ks v = some pe)) vs

def smd.removeItems (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal) (R : smd.PathSet) : smd.UVal
    :=
  smd.removeAt S t R x

def smd.merge (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (l r : smd.UVal) : smd.UVal :=
  (smd.mergeF (l.size + r.size + 1) S t (some l) (some r)).getD smd.UVal.null

def smd.instDecidableConforms (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal) : Decidable
    (smd.conforms S t x) :=
  smd.instDecidableConforms._aux_1 S t x

def smd.empty : smd.PathSet :=
  smd.PathSet.empty

def smd.leafM (l r : Option smd.UVal) : Option smd.UVal :=
  match r with
  | some val => r
  | none => l

def smd.keyOf (ks : List GoString) : smd.UVal → Option smd.PE :=
  match x✝ with
  | smd.UVal.map kvs =>
    have fl := List.filterMap (fun k => Option.map (fun v => (k, v)) (smd.lookupKV k kvs)) ks;
    if fl = [] then none else some (smd.PE.key (smd.flSort fl))
  | x => none
